name: cja_sdr_diff
description: Compare CJA data view snapshots to detect schema drift, additions, removals, and modifications over time. Supports direct data view comparison, snapshot-based diff, previous-snapshot comparison, and comparing two snapshot files on disk.

command.description: Diff command to run. 'diff' compares two live data views (source and target required). 'diff_snapshot' compares a live data view (source) against a snapshot file (snapshot). 'compare_with_prev' diffs a data view against its previous snapshot. 'compare_snapshots' diffs two snapshot files on disk (compare_snapshots_source and compare_snapshots_target required).

source.description: Source data view ID for the 'diff' command (the baseline / older side).

target.description: Target data view ID for the 'diff' command (the current / newer side).

compare_snapshots_source.description: File path to the source (older) snapshot JSON file for the 'compare_snapshots' command.

compare_snapshots_target.description: File path to the target (newer) snapshot JSON file for the 'compare_snapshots' command.

snapshot.description: File path to an existing baseline snapshot JSON file for the 'diff_snapshot' command. New snapshots are only written via auto_snapshot into snapshot_dir.

format.description: Output format for the diff report. Use 'json' for agent/machine-readable output.

output.description: Use '-' or 'stdout' to emit JSON diff output on stdout. To write the diff to a named file instead, use diff_output: it captures console text and format_pr_comment output, and names the 'json', 'markdown', 'html', or 'excel' report. Without diff_output, file-writing formats ('json', 'markdown', 'html', 'excel', 'csv') create auto-named artifacts under output_dir.

diff_output.description: Named file path for the diff. Captures the rendered text for 'console' output and for PR-comment mode when format_pr_comment is true. For 'json', 'markdown', 'html', and 'excel', the report is written to this exact path instead of an auto-named artifact under output_dir. 'csv' writes several files, so it ignores this path, writes auto-named artifacts under output_dir, and prints a warning on stderr.

output_dir.description: Directory where file-writing diff formats ('json', 'markdown', 'html', 'excel', 'csv') create auto-named artifacts.

format_pr_comment.description: When true, emit GitHub/GitLab PR comment markdown via the CLI's --format-pr-comment flag instead of the regular diff format.

agent_mode.description: Enable agent mode: suppresses banners, emits structured JSON to stdout. Recommended for programmatic diff consumption.

changes_only.description: When true, omit unchanged components from the diff output. Reduces noise for large data views with few changes.

include_metadata_changes.description: When true, pass --include-metadata-changes so data view name, owner, and description changes count as changes for the exit code and has_changes. Default: metadata changes are reported in summary.metadata_changes but not counted.

profile.description: Named credential profile to use. Defaults to the default profile.

run_summary_json.description: File path to write a machine-readable run summary JSON (timing, change counts, exit code) after the diff completes.
